$comment: Crew radio script, one entry per line id. 'role' picks the speaking voice (commander = voice A; gunner/loader/driver = voice B). 'delivery' is the ElevenLabs v4 audio-tag direction (English, prefixed in brackets at generation time): controlled, professional, never cheering or panicked. 'en-US' is the master; every other language is the register that country's armoured crews use over the intercom, not a literal translation. Keep takes short: crew radio, 1-6 words.
